title: No Returntype Enforced
content: A return type on a method means that the method must return something of that type. This is true, unless for generators. Such methods contains ``yield`` or ``yield from``, and must use the ``Generator`` returntype. Then, the actual return type is not checked, at all.
code:
<?php

function foo() : Generator {
    yield 1;

    return 'not a generator';
}

foreach($g = foo() as $b) {
    print $b;  // print 1
}

echo $g->getReturn(); // print 'not a generator'

?>
